top_choice_rationale: GLP-1 incretin physiology and identification of the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide by Drucker, Holst and Mojsov is a mature, mechanistically complete discovery whose clinical consequences were confirmed in large randomized trials for type 2 diabetes, obesity and cardiovascular and renal outcomes. The three-laureate allocation with a citation limited to incretin physiology and the active form avoids a priority claim on the incretin concept and credits discovery rather than drug development. No award is clearly inferior to an award of this maturity and impact.
